hero.alt: A wide shot of a jam session: musicians in the centre on rugs, an audience sitting around them on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, with neon pyramid lights and the mandala above.
hero.caption: A full circle: musicians in the middle, and listeners on cane stools, beanbags and the floor, between glowing neon pyramids.

more.alt: A long-haired, bearded musician in a light denim jacket plays ukulele at a microphone, next to a guitarist in a plaid shirt.
more.caption: A ukulele and a guitar at the sanctuary microphones.

more.alt: Silver and pink confetti pours over a smiling crowd sitting on the floor, many holding up phones.
more.caption: Then the confetti.
